description: This file defines request handlers for 'talk' related operations in a gateway server, including configuration retrieval, speech synthesis, and mode control, with external dependencies on configuration, TTS, and protocol modules.

methods.name: canReadTalkSecrets
methods.description: Checks if the client has scopes that permit reading talk secrets.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims a string value, returning undefined if input is not a string or empty.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if applicable.

methods.name: normalizeAliasKey
methods.description: Normalizes alias keys to lowercase trimmed strings.

methods.name: resolveTalkVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves a requested voice ID to a configured voice ID using aliases.

methods.name: buildTalkTtsConfig
methods.description: Builds TTS configuration for talk, resolving provider and configs.

methods.name: buildTalkSpeakOverrides
methods.description: Builds speech overrides for talk based on provider and parameters.

methods.name: inferMimeType
methods.description: Infers MIME type based on output format and file extension.
